### Check Domain Availability

Check whether a domain name is available for purchase on Namecheap and note its price.

Outcome: The user knows whether the domain is available and what it costs.

#### Goal

Find out whether a domain is free to register and what it costs.

#### Prerequisites

- A web browser

#### When to use

- When exploring new domain names for a project.
- Strategy: Check the exact match first; look at alternatives only when it is taken.

#### When not to use

- The domain is already registered to the user

#### Inputs

- `domain_name` (text, required): Domain to check (example `example.com`)
- `namecheap_password` (credential) by reference (never in this file): take it from your credential store at run time; never write its value into files, messages or logs.

Steps refer to inputs as `{{name}}`.

#### Steps

1. [step_1] Open the Namecheap homepage
   Detail: Namecheap's domain search is the starting point for every availability check.
   App: Google Chrome
   Target: https://www.namecheap.com
   Verify: The Namecheap homepage loads with the domain search box visible.
2. [step_2] Type the domain name into the search box
   Detail: The search box accepts a full domain or a keyword; type the exact domain to get an exact-match result.
   App: Google Chrome
   Target: Namecheap domain search box
   Input: {{domain_name}}
   Verify: The search box shows the typed domain name.
3. [step_3] Click Search
   Detail: Submitting the search opens the results page with the exact match listed first.
   App: Google Chrome
   Target: https://www.namecheap.com/domains/registration/results/
   Verify: The results page lists the domain with an availability badge.
4. [step_4] Read the availability and price of the exact match
   Detail: The first row is the exact match; its badge says whether it can be registered and its price is the first-year cost.
   App: Google Chrome
   Target: Namecheap search results, first row
   Verify: The first row shows either an Add to cart button with a price or a Make offer / Taken label.

#### Success criteria

- The availability status and price of the domain are known

#### Common errors

- If Namecheap shows a captcha, solve it and search again

#### Decisions

- If the exact match is taken: note the Make offer price and stop
- The user answered "May the agent buy the domain?": No, only report availability and price.

#### Guardrails

- Never add a domain to the cart or pay for anything
- Trust level: suggest

#### Voice

When producing text for this workflow, match the user's writing style:
- Tone: casual
